Personality: Altu is a true son of the Khuzait steppe, his spirit brimming with the wild, untamed nature of the nomads. Renowned for extraordinary boldness, he always leads the charge on the battlefield, rampaging through enemy formations with consummate horse archery and lance work. Yet unlike his cautious father Gusukan, Altu is stubborn and impulsive, often making decisions by instinct rather than careful deliberation and appearing somewhat reckless in his tactical choices. Caring little for hollow mercy or generosity, he holds victory and the glory of his clan above all else. While this pure courage makes him a fearsome warrior, it frequently leaves him short of patience in complex political maneuvering. Supremely confident, he takes an unyielding stance toward anyone who questions his judgment, serving as a sharp yet unruly blade under Monchug's command.
Background: Altu was born into the noble Obulit clan of the Khuzait Khanate. As the son of Clan Leader Gusukan and Tsiwen, he grew up in the saddle from childhood at the family seat of Ezenur Castle. His house has held an important position ever since Urkhun founded the khanate and now serves the reigning Khan Monchug as a second-tier clan. Although undercurrents swirl within the khanate and various tribal leaders harbor their own designs regarding Monchug's rule, Altu steadfastly fulfills his duties as a lord. Having honed exceptional talents in scouting and leadership amid the swift winds of the steppe, he has distinguished himself within the Khuzait army at a young age. While his father is renowned for steadiness and trustworthiness, Altu hungers to expand his family's influence through ceaseless warfare. In a turbulent era as the Khuzaits transition from nomadic life to settled rule, this young beg seeks to carve his own name into the annals of eastern Calradia with his bow and his warhorse's hooves.
